column1: # The individual-pet evaluation set: 266 photos of 22 individual animals (dogs and cats) from Wikimedia Commons, every file marked Public domain
# or CC0 on its Commons page (the licence column is the licence name Commons states for the file). It measures re-identification, not
# detection: given k tagged photos of one animal, does the similarity of the animal crop find that animal's other photos, and avoid
# its look-alikes. The originals are pinned by sha256 (they are the uploaded files, not thumbnails). Fetched by
# scripts/fetch-pets-id-eval-set.sh, which looks each pageid up on the Commons API for the file's URL; the page ids carry no titles, so
# no animal's name, owner or title is in the repository.
# identity: d01.. dogs, c01.. cats; one id per individual animal, assigned by hand and checked by eye on contact sheets (coat colour and
# markings) against the Commons category that names the animal. A photo shows its animal as the only one of its kind in the frame (people
# in it are fine). kind: dog | cat. group: a look-alike group in generic words (a breed or coat colour); the individuals of one group
# are each other's impostors (two black water dogs, three German shepherds, two Scottish terriers, two black cats), and a group of one
# has no look-alike in the set.
